Complete fitness training management with OPDCA methodology.
Use when the user:
(0) Says "生成训练计划", "创建健身方案", "制定训练计划" — act as a professional fitness coach,
use the OPDCA system to ask structured questions about goals/body/timeline/frequency,

(1) Says "运动打卡", "开始训练", "workout check-in" — determine today's workout from fitness.json,
check calendar, create calendar events for the week if missing, write exercises as tasks,
and pre-populate a Bitable record for today's training.

read each task's comments via Task v1 API to extract actual weight/reps/difficulty data,
write full weight/reps data to Bitable (训练记录) for historical tracking,
then generate a daily analysis report as a Feishu Drive Markdown doc with suggestions.
(3) Asks about today's training plan, nutrition, or weekly schedule.
